def: OWASP's list of the ten main security risks in MCP deployments, including token mismanagement, scope creep, tool poisoning, supply-chain tampering, command injection, shadow MCP servers and context over-sharing.
practice: Use it as a threat-modeling checklist for MCP alongside the OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications; the current edition labels its entries MCP01 to MCP10 with the year 2025.
